Kelley & VerPlanck Historical Resources Consulting, Bayview-Hunters Point Area B Survey: Town Center Activity Node — Historic Context Statement, prepared for the San Francisco Redevelopment Agency, adopted February 11, 2010

hook: An Eastlake dwelling and carriage house of 1895, recorded in the 1968 Here Today survey.

historic_survey.survey: Bayview-Hunters Point Area B Survey, Town Center Activity Node
historic_survey.cr_status_note: Assigned on architectural criteria alone; the survey records it as provisional pending further research.
historic_survey.rating_note: The survey reports ratings from the 1976 citywide architectural survey on a 0-5 scale, 5 being individual significance of the highest degree. It gives no scale for the Carey & Company or UMB survey ratings, so those are recorded here but not shown on the page.

historical_record.description: Built as an Eastlake-style dwelling with a carriage house. The 2010 survey calls it an Eastlake farmhouse in its inventory table and an elaborate if dilapidated Queen Anne dwelling in its recommendations.
